name: gmail-pdf-archiver
description: Seamlessly download and archive your Gmail conversations as high-quality PDFs with all attachments included.

scripts.build: rm -rf dist && mkdir -p dist && cp -r src/* dist/ && cp -r assets dist/ && terser dist/background.js -o dist/background.js -c -m && terser dist/content.js -o dist/content.js -c -m
